note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), French Polynesia, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in XPF of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), searched again on 2026-11-03 in the statistics office's own accounts for a households' disposable income account from 2019 on, found none: ISPF "Les comptes économiques définitifs de 2021" (ispf.pf/publication/les-comptes-economiques-definitifs-de-2021, PDF and data workbook 1509_Comptes_definitifs_2021_data_97b9dd07d6.xlsx), read 2026-11-03: households gross disposable income 2021 is given ("Le revenu disponible brut (RDB) des ménages atteint 516,6 milliards de F.CFP"), but no national income, gross or net, appears in the PDF or the workbook. CEROM/ISPF "Comptes économiques rapides 2024" (cerom-outremer.fr/IMG/pdf/202508_1492_comptes_rapides_2024.pdf), read 2026-11-03: TABLE 2 "Les comptes des ménages" gives "Revenu disponible 564 584" (2023e, 2024e, milliards de F.CFP), a model estimate; no national income. ISPF theme page ispf.pf/themes/pib, read 2026-11-03: files are GDP resource-use balances (TRE) only. With no published national income the ratio cannot be formed; the household figure is recorded here so it is not searched for again. Each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included.
